description: Main API server setup for real-time OEE monitoring system using FastAPI, including CORS middleware, database initialization with retries, and health check endpoints.

classes.name: FastAPI
classes.description: Main application object for the API server.

methods.description: Platform health endpoint, lightweight, indicates service readiness.
